newsitem.title: USA: SI Diamond in alliance with Nomura, ISE.
newsitem.headline: SI Diamond in alliance with Nomura, ISE.

text.p: SI Diamond Technology Inc said on Monday it formed an alliance with Nomura Trading Co Ltd and ISE Electronics Corp of Mie, Japan, to use SI Diamond's thin-film technology in making large-screen displays.

Under the terms of the agreement, a Nomura unit, Diamond Pro-Shop Nomura Co Ltd, would buy 50 preferred shares of SI Diamond's subsidiary Field Emission Picture Element Technology Inc, convertible into five percent of Field Emission's outstanding common stock for $500,000.

Field Emission and ISE, meanwhile, would enter into a joint agreement to develop field emission picture elements for large screen displays using Field Emission's thin-film technology. Field Emission would supply cathodes and ISE would design and manufacture the picture elements for commercial production, SI Diamond said.
In return for its investment, Nomura gets exclusive rights to import SI Diamond's cathodes to Japan and to use or sub-license their use for manufacturing in that country.
ISE gets non-exclusive marketing rights worldwide for the cathodes in large screen displays, except for electronic billboard applications.
